resources.string: Three things to set up. Use the direction buttons and OK.
While watching, press Home and open Hearth controls to hide, move, pause or stop the overlay.
Set up speech for your TV
Turn device audio or microphone speech into captions.
Choose the language you want to read.
Choose a voice and hear captions or translations aloud.
OpenAI for speech, translation and voices. One key, saved on this TV.
This build stays offline. Import speech and translation models and use the device voice.
Enter your OpenAI key once for speech, translation and TTS. Leave blank to keep a saved OpenAI key. Your provider may charge for usage.
Saved. Provider connections are checked when you start.
Use original captions or translate into your chosen language. Set up STT first.
Voice and volume changes apply to new spoken lines. Read aloud stays off until you enable it.
Save your OpenAI setup in STT first.
Speech and translation models are ready on this TV.
Press Home and open your video app. Captions appear over it; they stay out of the way while you use Hearth.
Set up once from your phone. Keep Start and Stop one press away.
Start Hearth, then open your video app. Stop ends captions and read-aloud.
Your phone can set up all three in one go.
